NAME

quoted-contexts - retain conditional source order

DESCRIPTION

C01 Header assignment: accepted.

C02 The initial value matches.

C03 The body assignment takes effect.

C04 Body assignment: accepted.

C05 A quoted comparison nests inside ifdef.

C06 Active nested comparisons include their content.

C07 Closing the inner comparison restores its parent.

  • C08 A conditional list item remains a list.
C09 A conditional listing remains a listing.

C10 Formatting remains available in included content.

C11 Final content keeps its original source location.
